text_simplified: Luqman the Wise began his counsel to his son by forbidding shirk and explaining that it is the gravest injustice, then reminded him of the vastness of Allah's knowledge and His encompassing even the weight of a mustard seed in a rock, the heavens, or the earth. Planting this aqeedah in children's hearts strengthens their station of ihsan and mindfulness of Allah in all their actions, especially with the spread of modern devices and the harmful content they may broadcast.
